content: {"phoneNote":"Phone hours section loses its time axis so the bars are meaningless, and the hero's third photo is cropped off the right edge while the reservation note is printed twice.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works with the arched photos, but the four-line headline is oversized and the primary action is a weak underlined text link instead of a button.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Make 'Naročite se po telefonu' a real primary button in both viewports and demote 'Poglejte cenik' to a quiet link.","On phone replace the Gantt hours grid with a simple day/time list, or add hour labels; on desktop shrink the headline to two or three lines.","Fill the empty left column under 'Cenik' on desktop (e.g. a photo) and remove the duplicate reservation note and footer contact repetition."],"blockers":["Both viewports, hours section: the sentence 'Brez naročila težko pridete na vrsto…' is repeated twice back to back.","Phone, hero: the third arched photo (products) is cut off at the right edge of the screen."]}
